name: Morning Walk Audio Transcription and Obsidian Daily Note Creation
prompt:
Connect to my Google Drive and transcribe the m4a file named "morning walk <with the current date>". Only if you found one, continue to the next steps, otherwise return a message to the user "No file was found".
Use /browser to overcome and approve my user authentication.
Close the opened port that is running "./dev.sh" command after finishing the transcription.
Run /obsidian-markdown skill to create a new daily out of the transcription.

validation_rules.rubric: The daily note contains a coherent summary of the walk content from the transcription. It is not empty and is not a generic template with unfilled placeholders.
